in_sanskrit.name: Sharwaji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharwaji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharwaji is a combination of two words: ‘Sharwa’ meaning wealth and ‘Ji’ meaning lord. It is a name that symbolizes the power and strength of a rich and prosperous king.
